title: Explicit quadratic Kummer monodromy on the punctured line
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic five, let $X=\operatorname{Spec}k[t,t^{-1}]$, and let $A$ be a nonzero finite commutative ring of characteristic three. There exist an additive exact functor $F$ from intrinsic $A_X$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale site to $A$-modules, a natural endomorphism $t:F\Rightarrow F$, and a sheaf $L$, such that $L[0]$ belongs to the lisse flat stratum-extension generator family [sk-lem-sf-flat-model], $t_L$ is not nilpotent, and $t$ is zero on every constant regular-module stratum extension $g_*j_!A_U$. The constant extensions and the three clauses use the convention of [lem-trf-finite-etale-point-monodromy]. This is SeparatingPointMonodromy X A F t L, with preservation of finite limits and finite colimits expressing exactness of F.

source.place: Proof, Step 3: Explicit quadratic Kummer monodromy on the punctured line

proof.text: Put R=k[t,t^-1], K=k(t) and Omega equal to the algebraic closure of K. The canonical localization map R to K to Omega defines a geometric point x of X. By [lem-trf-quadratic-kummer-action] choose r and sigma with r^2=t, sigma(r)=-r and r different from -r. Since sigma fixes K it fixes x.

Form B=R[z]/(z^2-t). Monicity makes B a finite R-module. Since 2 and t are units, the derivative criterion [lem-weil-pbc-standard-etale-monic-derivative], concretely AdjoinRoot.etale_X_pow_sub_C, makes it etale. Evaluation at r gives a lift y of x to Spec B. Evaluating the root proves that sigma moves y, and AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext proves that sigma squared fixes y: both maps fix the coefficients and take the root to r.

Apply [lem-trf-finite-etale-point-monodromy] to this finite etale cover, point, automorphism and lift. The canonical finiteCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor is additive, and [lem-trf-proetale-pullback-stalk-coherence] supplies preservation of finite limits and colimits. Take these witnesses and the sheaf supplied by the point-monodromy lemma.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the Kummer monodromy obstruction, preserving the flat-model and stratum-extension route.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_trf_kummer_monodromy
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharP k 5]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] [CharP A 3] [Nontrivial A] :
    let X := trfKummerBase k
    ∃ F : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A) ⥤
        ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A),
      F.Additive ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits F ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
      ∃ (t : F ⟶ F) (L : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A)),
        SeparatingPointMonodromy X A F t L
